n = len(s)

    if i + 2 <= n and s[i:i+2] == "at" and not at_done and i != 0 and i != n - 2:
        res.append('@')
        at_done = True
        i += 2

        res.append('.')
        i += 3
    else:
        res.append(s[i])
        i += 1
print(''.join(res))
